# Sekura reference assets

Vendored, unmodified from the [Sekura Design System](https://apps.tsiortos.com/sekuradesign),
design-system version 3.2.0:

- `sekura.css`: https://apps.tsiortos.com/sekuradesign/css/sekura.css
- `sekura.iife.min.js`: https://apps.tsiortos.com/sekuradesign/js/sekura.iife.min.js

The CSS includes the system's semantic tokens and component styles. The
JavaScript supplies the drawer, dialog and notification controllers. Product
integration and overrides live outside this directory. All assets are embedded
in the executable; the running app does not contact the design-system service.

Consult the upstream documentation and terms when updating these reference
assets. Pi-Manager's MIT license does not relicense third-party assets.
